verdict.rationale: Vercel Sandbox documents a programmatic SDK (`@vercel/sandbox`) for creating sandboxes, running blocking or detached commands, streaming logs, managing files and extending timeouts. Token-based auth covers non-Vercel environments, a scriptable `sandbox` CLI exists, and a probe found a live OpenAPI spec at vercel.com/openapi.json. missing for 10: confirmation that the OpenAPI spec actually covers Sandbox endpoints (raw REST reference), SDK coverage beyond JavaScript/TypeScript, independent or hands-on corroboration of driving the API.
